content:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Alert group 'dedicated-cluster-errors' fired for shard us-west-2-3 — elevated 5xx and 504 rates, >10% error ratio over 5m. Pager sent to on-call.

marta-sre: ack. I'm on it. pulling SLO dashboards now.

liam-oncall: oncall ack, joining. tagging infra and eng. @sophie-eng can you pull GPU and queue metrics for that shard?

sophie-eng: looking. cluster us-west-2-3: GPU util 97-99% across pods, inflight requests per node spiked to ~420, request queue depth ~130 on the frontend LB. KV eviction rate up; paging to disk visible on ssd-io graphs.

noah-support: customer Orpheus reported "model calls timing out and 502s" ~15m ago. They sent a sample trace showing repeated upstream resets.

raj-customer-success: Orpheus (prod) impact: 35% of requests failing for a portion of users, biggest impact on our gen endpoint /v1/generate. They're seeing timeouts in their app and are concerned.

marta-sre: ok summary: high concurrency + KV paging causing slow tails -> upstream proxies closing connections -> 502/504s. Looks like capacity starvation rather than a code regression.

liam-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle Orpheus to their committed rate, 2) route new traffic for that tenant to fallback pool (dedicated-burst or hosted), 3) add temporary capacity if available. Sophie, can you prepare the routing change? Marta, confirm which nodes to scale.

sophie-eng: ready. routing change snippet (will apply via control-plane):

```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: tenant == "orpheus-prod"
    action: route_to: dedicated-burst
    fallback: hosted-us
    rate_limit: 300rps
```

sophie-eng: running dry-run validation... config ok. will apply in 60s unless objections.

liam-oncall: apply now. execute and monitor.

ops-bot: exec: apply-route --tenant orpheus-prod --target dedicated-burst --rate 300

ops-bot: result: route change accepted by control-plane; traffic drain started.

noah-support: notifying customer Orpheus: "We've applied temporary routing to reduce errors and are adding capacity. You may see some throttling while we stabilize."

raj-customer-success: Orpheus response: "Thanks - still seeing errors but fewer. Any ETA?"

marta-sre: monitoring p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate. current 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 4% in the first 3 minutes after reroute. backend queue depth trending down.

sophie-eng: captured a sample nginx upstream error from the proxy logs:

```
[2026-04-02T14:12:03Z] upstream: "upstream prematurely closed connection" peer="10.32.7.89:8080" status=502 request_id=abc123 tenant=orpheus-prod
```

sophie-eng: also seeing kernel-level page faults on model host indicating heavy swap usage during peak sequences. likely model kv cache evictions due to memory pressure.

liam-oncall: can we spin up two spare pods in us-west-2-3 to catch overflow? how long to provision?

marta-sre: autoscaler has limited headroom on that pool; I can bring up two extra reserved instances from the spare pool — ~4m to boot. doing that now.

ops-bot: exec: scale-pool --pool us-west-2-3-spare --count +2

ops-bot: result: provisioning started (instances 2x p4d-sim).

sophie-eng: in parallel, adding a small KV cache-size bump for orpheus model routing to reduce paging (temporary). config change: cache.target=0.75 -> 0.85. applying.

marta-sre: cache change applied. also applied a protective circuit-breaker to limit inflight per-connection to 8 for Orpheus.

noah-support: Orpheus portal message posted: "We've applied temporary protections and routing to reduce errors. We'll follow up with planned remediation."

liam-oncall: update on metrics: 5xx now 1.6%, 504s near zero. GPU util still high but queue depth back to ~20. provisioning completed, new nodes joined and drained some load.

raj-customer-success: customer says "errors reduced to acceptable levels, thanks — please keep us posted on root cause."

marta-sre: next steps: - create incident ticket and assign postmortem - compute cost/impact and whether tenant exceeded committed concurrency - evaluate long-term mitigation (limit per-tenant concurrent requests, improve autoscaler headroom, refine cache sizing heuristics)

sophie-eng: note: we should add an alert for swap/page-fault increases on model hosts (early signal for paging) and surface KV eviction rate in tenant health.

liam-oncall: agreed. I'll open a follow-up RFC for autoscaler headroom and tenant backpressure policy.

deploy-bot: RESOLVED: Alert group 'dedicated-cluster-errors' for shard us-west-2-3 recovered.

marta-sre: closing here. Will file postmortem and tag Orpheus impact. thanks everyone for quick moves. :white_check_mark:

noah-support: linking customer's support ticket #CS-2026-789 for follow-up and credits discussion.

liam-oncall: final note: action items assigned in the incident ticket. low-severity follow-ups for infra/eng.

marta-sre: postmortem owners: marta-sre (lead), sophie-eng (root cause), liam-oncall (mitigation).
